stem_book: Two tall buildings are 30 m apart. The speed with which a ball must be thrown horizontally from a window 150 m above the ground in one building so that it enters a window 27.5 m from the ground in the other building is: (take g = 9.8 m/s²) (a) 2 ms⁻¹ (b) 6 ms⁻¹ (c) 4 ms⁻¹ (d) 8 ms⁻¹
reason: print drops the unit of 27.5 (m); g = 9.8 m/s² needed for the exact 6 (g = 10 gives 6.06) — added to stem
